item.title: New Advances in Biofuel vs Fossil fuels for Future Technology used in NLP
item.description: New Advances in Biofuel vs Fossil fuels for Future Technology used in NLP Pollution on all scales is a topic of growing social concern. In this century, words like "recycling" and "valuation of waste and by-products with polluting potential" have become increasingly common. These words refer to actions that support policies focused on cost savings, are less and less dependent on oil, and respect the goals of the circular economy. Numerous international groups are debating the future of biofuels.
